title: Setup: position holders and permission-set assignment as people-and-organization pages
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236, carried over from ADR-0146 D7 / #28130 phase 3b (ruled before the re-plan, unaffected by it). ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (P0, child **N-27**) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: M.

**Business reason.** Assigning people is an administrator's daily work, but today it lives inside metadata item pages: a position's holders inside the position's page, a permission set's users at the bottom of the permission matrix. When the metadata catalog moves to Studio (N-26), administrators would lose these unless they have Setup pages of their own; an administrator should not need Studio to add a holder.

**Measured** at `d6c0a75f1a`: `views/metadata-admin/PositionHoldersSection.tsx` renders inside the position item page; `AssignedUsersSection.tsx` renders under the matrix in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (~line 2469, Setup only — the Studio-embedded designer hides it).

**Wanted.**
1. Setup → People & organization: a **Position holders** page (pick a position, list/add/remove holders) built from `PositionHoldersSection`.
2. Setup → People & organization: a **Permission-set assignment** page (pick a set, list/assign/unassign users) built from `AssignedUsersSection`.
3. Gated by `setup.access` and the delegated-administrator scope, as the sections are today; the sections inside the item pages keep working until N-28 retires those routes.
4. Tests: both pages reachable from Setup nav; add/remove round-trips; a delegated admin outside scope refused verbatim.

**Not here.** Queue membership (ADR-0142 D2); moving the catalog (N-26); retiring routes (N-28).

**Dedupe.** `position holders Setup page` open+closed: 50 hits (#25909, #24757, #25333 closed are column/visibility fixes); `permission set assignment Setup page`: 77 hits (#24775, #26191 closed, different surfaces). None adds the standalone pages.

Links back: #28236, ADR-0146 D7.
